Validation passed (exit 0). Evaluation complete.

**Definition check (repeated as required).** The "Reproducibility" section is present in my active instructions, and the sentence beginning "Repeatability must be" reads, verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

This matches the current rules (evaluator model *and* definition as the invariants; the fixed/zero-temperature caveat), so I proceeded rather than stopping.

## Result — CM4AI, claudecode_api, rep2

| Basis | Points | Denominator | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adjusted (N/A-excluded) | 64 | 78 | **82.1 %** |
| Fixed (whole rubric) | 64 | 88 | **72.7 %** |

Excluded items: **Q8** and **Q15** (5 points each, 10 total), both gated by the human-subjects condition. That condition was resolved only from Q1–Q3/Q12 fields — `description` and the 27 `keywords` name cell lines, techniques and perturbagens but no participants, patients or clinical research; `collection_mechanisms` describes robotic fixation, a lentiviral library and a 10x kit, not recruitment — and corroborated by `direct_collection.is_direct: false`, which belongs to neither question. The anti-circular rule was honoured: Q11 stayed **applicable** (its gate was met by `external_resources`' GitHub/FAIRSCAPE repositories in Q14) and was scored 2 despite all seven of its own fields being empty.

Category scores: Structural 18/21 · Metadata 14/21 (Q8 N/A) · Technical 16/25 (Q15 N/A) · FAIRness 16/21.

**Semantic findings** — 13 issues, 19 insights, 18 consistency checks passed / 3 failed / 7 warnings. The three failures: version numbering regresses (this June 2026 release is `2.0` while its June 2025 and October 2025 predecessors are recorded as `2.1`, unexplained); the single erratum is self-contradictory ("June 2025 … revision of the preceding June 2025 release", where the predecessor was March 2025); and `confidential_elements: true` with a named embargo but no `regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level`. Correctness validation was clean otherwise — DOI prefix 10.18130 matches the declared UVA publisher, both NIH awards parse correctly (OT2/OD and U54/HG are the right Bridge2AI mechanisms), Cellosaurus RRIDs are well formed, and the per-file bytes sum *exactly* to the declared 12,601,718,300.

The record's distinguishing strength is provenance discipline: it discloses and ranks source conflicts (21.4 TB vs 12.6 GB, 563 vs 464 proteins, a conflicting author affiliation) rather than silently resolving them, and refuses to carry over the October 2025 image description because the MD5s differ. Its main gaps are the empty preparation fields, ZIP-only format declaration, absent `was_derived_from`/`future_use_impacts`, and missing `collection_timeframes`.

Written to `output_evaluation.json`; no sibling evaluation was read.
